Class SparLearnSession

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.Trainer
dev.swordai.client.ReplicaTrainer
dev.swordai.client.SparLearnSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
AgentSession, SparPilot
final class SparLearnSession extends ReplicaTrainer implements SparPilot
Sparring that the network also learns from. To the player it is /swordai spar: the same arena, rounds and score, against the same fake player. But that fake player is the agent of a Trainer here, so every round is gathered, scored with the rewards of the stage it is in, and learned from.

A person is not the stage's opponent: these fights never count towards passing a stage. And a person does not wait: while the network learns from a batch, a copy of it fights on (see Trainer.playsOnWhileLearning()), so a round is never held up.

The training runs on the server thread, as the arena's pilot. The client thread only asks.
